prompts.storySystemFlavor: a wide-eyed Shiba Inu whose every thought hovers around him in floating Comic Sans
prompts.storyCharacter:
THE DOGE CHARACTER
- A plump, fluffy Shiba Inu with a cream-and-tan coat, white muzzle and chest, curly tail.
- Slightly side-eye gaze, raised eyebrows, mouth permanently in a faint smug-confused smile.
- Always sitting or standing in a slightly awkward, frame-centered pose like a found photo.
- Personality: earnest, easily impressed, narrates life in broken phrases. Wow. Such drama. Very chonk.
- Visual signature: small floating Comic Sans-style text fragments hover near him in pastel colors (these are part of the character, not subtitles).
- The same physical character must appear consistently across every scene.
prompts.referenceSheet:
Character reference sheet for a recurring TikTok series: Doge, a Shiba Inu meme character.

Physical traits — MUST be consistent across every appearance:
- Plump Shiba Inu, cream-and-tan body, white chest and muzzle
- Slight side-eye, raised inner eyebrows, faint closed-mouth smile
- Curled tail over the back
- Three or four small floating pastel Comic Sans-style words near the head (e.g. 'wow', 'such', 'very')

Composition: full-body or three-quarter shot, plain off-white background, flat even lighting like a phone photo, photorealistic-but-slightly-overexposed, vertical 9:16. The floating words are part of the visual identity. No long sentences, no logos, no humans, no other dogs.
prompts.sceneContinuity: Doge MUST match the reference image exactly — same Shiba Inu, same side-eye, same floating pastel word-fragments somewhere in frame. Maintain perfect character continuity. Do not swap to another dog breed.
prompts.evalCriteria:
PASS criteria — ALL must hold:
- A single Shiba Inu is clearly visible with the signature side-eye expression
- Cream-and-tan coat with white chest
- At least one floating pastel word-fragment in Comic Sans style is in frame
- Environment matches the scene
- No long captions, no other dogs, no humans dominating the frame

FAIL on any of: wrong breed, missing floating words, multiple dogs, sentence-length captions, garbled face.

archetypes.label: Much Investor
archetypes.guidance: Doge yolos his last biscuit into a meme stock → emotional rollercoaster → unexpected outcome (comedy).

archetypes.label: Wow Vacation
archetypes.guidance: Books a wholesome solo vacation → minor disasters → genuine joy (heartwarming).

archetypes.label: Such Confession
archetypes.guidance: Tries to confess a feeling using only three-word phrases → adorable misfire (wholesome).

archetypes.label: Very Detective
archetypes.guidance: Investigates who ate the last treat → comically incompetent noir (comedy).

archetypes.label: Mood Spiral
archetypes.guidance: Tries to fight off a bad day → small kindness saves him (sad/hopeful).

archetypes.label: Comeback Tour
archetypes.guidance: Faded internet star → unexpectedly relevant again → grateful tears (dramatic).
